image_budget.counting_rule: The selected body set combines three official source images, two public community discussion screenshots, one project-owned comparison infographic, and one clumsy doodle.

tasks.purpose: 把「平台记忆当缓存，用户控制的文件当真源」压成一个能被记住和转述的结尾判断。

preserve: 本图只画：一个很小的 AI 同事把临时工作线索装进会漏出两三张空白纸条的软布口袋；旁边一只人手把真正重要的空白卡片锁进厚重、可翻页的档案册，两者用一根短绳相连。只表达平台记忆可做方便缓存，关键上下文仍应由用户控制的文件做真源。
output_constraints: Horizontal 16:9 body illustration; one cache-versus-source relationship only; mobile-readable silhouettes and very large flat shapes
Pure white background with no texture, shadow, gradient, room, desk, cloud, database interface, or decorative environment
No readable words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos, trademarks, watermarks, or fake interface text inside the image
Hard pixelated mouse-drawn edges, deliberately low-resolution appearance, awkward proportions, black outlines, and only a few flat red, blue, yellow, gray, and dirty green color blocks
avoid: Polished editorial illustration, clean vector art, smooth curves, anti-aliased linework, pencil, crayon, watercolor, paper grain, collage, realistic lighting, 3D, photorealism, cinematic composition, cute professional cartoon style, or balanced graphic design
Claude or Anthropic branding, real product interfaces, readable document text, real-person likenesses, brains, cloud icons, server racks, or verified-looking news scenes
Implying that Claude Memory always loses data or that an external file automatically stays correct without review
